scope: Complete declaration and disposition inventory of all 458 .slib symbol views in the two pinned GF180 standard-cell repositories. No electrical interface order, application adapter, runtime behavior or full source-completeness acceptance is inferred.
original_requirement: Map every upstream symbol/model/PCell/extracted mapping/library/process option to supported, unimplemented or inapplicable with a reason and source. This extension repairs a symbol-view omission under that original inventory requirement.
prior_omission: All 458 .slib files were in the authenticated file ledger as other-source-context, but their actual symbol and pin declarations had no item-level dispositions.
semantics: Symbol names come from literal declarations, not filenames.
Pin names retain case and source declaration order; this is explicitly not electrical netlist port order.
Source text is tokenized without executing it; unknown calls, dynamic identifiers, malformed/truncated records and duplicates remain explicit source errors.
Symbols join the existing per-cell library view reconciliation without claiming an available application adapter.
Only declaration facts, source positions, call counts and provenance identities enter the retained report; graphical expressions are not evaluated.

acquisition.authentication: Every complete source byte string matches its fixed Git blob identity and retained SHA-256; original source headers/notices are unchanged in the local cache.

remaining: The original .lib dio/.endl diode diagnostic remains unchanged, named and unimplemented; the historical GAPS report is not relabeled.
Other source categories and companion roots still require the separate complete disposition audit before any source-completeness matrix row changes.
Four required unavailable bindings and all remaining device-family, operating-envelope, extracted-connectivity and installed-release gates remain blockers.
redistribution: No upstream symbol code is newly copied into the repository. Authenticated original sources and Apache notices remain in the external cache; the new report contains generated declaration facts and hashes.
